The counsel for the applicant submits that in the present case, the complainant Punjab National Bank has already initiated proceedings under the SARFAESI Act, 2002 as well as the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.
He further submits that the investigation is complete and the Chargesheet has already been filed.
3. Status Report has been filed on behalf of the State.

As per the Status Report, the applicant along with his wife, who is also co-accused, registered a forged sale deed in their favour in respect of a property whose owner had already expired and on the basis of the said forged sale deed, took a huge loan amount from the bank.
